AXElement.description: One accessibility element of the frontmost app (role/title/frame); its value is never sent for secure fields.
AXElement.title: AXElement

AXSnapshot.description: The frontmost app's visible elements. Empty (and secure_field_focused) while a password field has focus.
AXSnapshot.title: AXSnapshot

DoneWhen.description: How the stepper knows a step is done: state predicates first; the user's "next" always works.
DoneWhen.title: DoneWhen

GuideStatusMsg.description: What the tutor is doing, for the phantom icon and its transcript ("Got it — planning…", "Step 2 of 5").
GuideStatusMsg.title: GuideStatusMsg

HomeworkPublic.description: What a student's device sees for a homework link: never who else did it.
HomeworkPublic.title: HomeworkPublic

InputEvent.description: That the user clicked or typed, and where they clicked. Keys carry no content, not even key codes.
InputEvent.title: InputEvent

LearningLog.description: Derived, deterministically, from what the store already holds (progress.py).
LearningLog.title: LearningLog

LineCorrection.description:
"Tell the tutor what you meant": what a line really says, typed (or dictated) by the student from a question
chip or a "?" mark. Only the reading changes; the ink is never touched.
LineCorrection.title: LineCorrection

LogLine.description: One checked line in the learning log (the reading is short text; no strokes, no images).
LogLine.title: LogLine

OverlayEvent.description: One thing the helper draws over the screen (or clears). It points; nothing here can act on the screen.
OverlayEvent.title: OverlayEvent

ScreenConfigMsg.description: Sent on connect. The helper skips blocklisted apps' windows before capture (Phase 12).
ScreenConfigMsg.title: ScreenConfigMsg

ScreenFrame.description: A downscaled screenshot of one display. Never leaves the Mac (screen mode is local-only).
ScreenFrame.title: ScreenFrame

ScreenHello.description: Sent on connect and whenever the display layout changes, so the server can keep boxes on screen.
ScreenHello.title: ScreenHello

SessionCreate.description: POST /api/sessions. `student` / `homework_id` come from a homework link (`/?hw=<id>`).
SessionCreate.title: SessionCreate

VoiceDictate.description: The next utterance fills the correction field for this line (it is not a question for the tutor).
VoiceDictate.title: VoiceDictate
